name: commerce/product-showcase
title: Product Showcase
description: A live product grid pulled from the catalog: newest, a category, items on sale, or hand-picked products by slug. Cards carry live prices, stock and add-to-cart.

aiHints.useFor: homepage featured products, category landing sections, sale sections, and hand-picked bundles that must show live prices and stock
aiHints.avoid: manual product cards with typed prices (use Product Collection) or a single product page
